node.title: glob() and dot files
node.author: perlancar
node.doctext:
A couple of questions on handling dotfiles with perl's glob(). Seems like bsd_glob() doesn't offer any special handling of dotfiles.

1. Is there an equivalent for "shopt -s dotglob"? Reading [metamod://File::Glob] indicates there isn't.

2. What would be the easiest to accomplish "listing all files/subdirectories including dotfiles/dotsubdirs but without the . and .." and "listing all dotfiles/dotsubdirs only, without the . and .."? I've given up on glob() for this and simply do something along the line of: @all_files_including_dot = do { opendir my $dh, "."; grep { $_ ne '.' && $_ ne '..' } readdir $dh }; @all_dotfiles = do { opendir my $dh, "."; grep { $_ ne '.' && $_ ne '..' && /\A\./ } readdir $dh };
